title: Annual review of selected scientific literature: A report of the Committee on Scientific Investigation of the American Academy of Restorative Dentistry
html: The Scientific Investigation Committee of the American Academy of Restorative Dentistry presents this review of selected 2025 dental literature. This, our sixty-ninth published report, remains focused on topics of interest to modern restorative dentists and prosthodontists. Each committee member contributes discipline-specific expertise in their respective fields, including (in order of presentation): conventional prosthodontics; implant prosthodontics; operative dentistry and direct restorative materials; caries and cariology; periodontics, alveolar bone, and peri-implant tissues; occlusion and temporomandibular disorders; sleep medicine and related topics; and oral and maxillofacial surgery, medicine, and radiology.
